name: gizza-ai/typescript-transpiler
summary: Strip TypeScript syntax into best-effort JavaScript.

tool.description: Transpile small TypeScript snippets to JavaScript locally by stripping type annotations, interfaces, type aliases, assertions, optional markers, modifiers, implements clauses, type-only imports/exports, and simple enum declarations. This is a deterministic syntax stripper, not a full TypeScript compiler or type checker.

enum_style.description: How to handle TypeScript enum declarations: compile them to simple JavaScript objects, or strip them as type-only declarations.

input.description: TypeScript source to convert into best-effort JavaScript by removing type-only syntax. Maximum 1 MB.

remove_comments.description: Remove line and block comments from the output in addition to stripping TypeScript syntax.
